---
title: "Data stores -- collections of data records"
---
The `scinexus` package provides [data store](https://scinexus.readthedocs.io/en/latest/howto/use-data-stores.html). A data store is a collection of data members of the same type (e.g. all `.fasta` files in a directory). Data stores allow you to apply an app or composed pipeline to many data records without writing loops.

## Using data stores with cogent3

Use the `open_data_store()` function to open a data store and a loader app (see [app types](https://scinexus.readthedocs.io/en/latest/explanation/app-lifecycle.html)) to read member data.

```{python}
from cogent3 import get_app, open_data_store

dstore = open_data_store("data/raw.zip", suffix="fa", mode="r")
print(dstore)
```

```{python}
loader = get_app("load_unaligned", moltype="dna")
seqs = loader(dstore[0])
seqs
```

## Applying a pipeline to a data store

```{python}
#| echo: false
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

tmpdir = TemporaryDirectory(dir=".")
path_to_dir = tmpdir.name
```

```{python}
out_dstore = open_data_store(path_to_dir, suffix="fa", mode="w")
loader = get_app("load_aligned", moltype="dna", format_name="fasta")
take3 = get_app("take_codon_positions", 3)
writer = get_app("write_seqs", data_store=out_dstore, format_name="fasta")
app = loader + take3 + writer
result = app.apply_to(dstore)
result.describe
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import shutil
shutil.rmtree(path_to_dir, ignore_errors=True)
```
